$comment: Canonical xAI / Grok-class speech-tag catalog for this kit. Verify against https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/audio/text-to-speech before treating a name as gospel.

inline.name: pause
inline.example: So I walked in and [pause] there it was.

inline.name: laugh
inline.example: [laugh] I honestly could not believe it!

inline.name: chuckle
inline.example: [chuckle] We've all been in that room.

inline.name: giggle
inline.example: Don't [giggle] start, I'm trying to be serious.

inline.name: cry
inline.example: I didn't expect it to land like that. [cry]

inline.name: hum-tune
inline.example: Give me a second. [hum-tune] Okay. Back.

inline.name: lip-smack
inline.example: [lip-smack] Alright. Here is the spicy bit.

inline.name: inhale
inline.example: [inhale] This is the part I wanted to get right.

wrapping.name: whisper
wrapping.example: I need to tell you something. <whisper>It is a secret.</whisper>

wrapping.name: soft
wrapping.example: <soft>Stay with me for this next number.</soft>

wrapping.name: build-intensity
wrapping.example: <build-intensity>And it kept growing. And growing. And then it broke.</build-intensity>

wrapping.name: emphasis
wrapping.example: The constraint is <emphasis>four minutes</emphasis>, not forty.

wrapping.name: fast
wrapping.example: <fast>Ship it, measure it, kill it if it lies.</fast>

wrapping.name: lower-pitch
wrapping.example: <lower-pitch>This is the part we do not joke about.</lower-pitch>

wrapping.name: laugh-speak
wrapping.example: <laugh-speak>We did put the graph in the appendix. Once.</laugh-speak>

not_native_xai.note: Some agent stacks (e.g. LiveKit expr dialect) use intermediate emotion labels like happy/sad/angry. Those are NOT xAI native tags. Lower them to the wrapping/inline tags above before calling POST /v1/tts.
